contexts.text: I will give prodigies in the heavens... (). AE 539, Explained.
They shall give great signs and prodigies () = things which confirm and persuade from external appearances and fallacies, by which the simple suffer themselves to be seduced. Explained.
I will multiply My signs and My prodigies () = admonitions of every kind... Signs and prodigies = confirmations of the Truth; and also the media of Divine power; here, admonitions. Explained.
Give a prodigy () = and therefore want to be confirmed, Prodigies and signs = confirmations of Truths.

As to prodigies and signs... they were done with such as were in external worship, and did not want to know about internal; for those in such worship had to be driven by external means. (Continued. See Miracle.)
This prodigy = the first admonition with those who infest. Explained.
The signification of the prodigy which precedes.
The prodigies and signs which were done in Egypt = vastations and thence confirmations that they are in evil; for those prodigies = so many degrees of their vastation. AC 7796.
To give great signs and prodigies = the efficacy and power of falsities through confirmations from the sense of the letter... Through this, signs and prodigies are effected in the Spiritual World...
